Tommy Hilfiger Urbana Laptop Backpack

The Tommy Hilfiger Urbana Laptop Backpack is a perfect blend of style, comfort, and functionality, designed for modern professionals, students, and travelers who value practicality with a premium fashion appeal. Staying true to the brand’s heritage, the backpack reflects the essence of classic American cool with a refreshing, contemporary twist. Whether you’re heading to work, college, or a casual outing, this backpack delivers superior organization, durability, and timeless design.

Crafted with high-quality materials, the Urbana series stands out for its sleek structure, lightweight build, and premium craftsmanship. The backpack offers a generous internal layout and reliable protection for your everyday essentials. Its ergonomic design and versatile aesthetics make it suitable for both men and women looking for a long-lasting lifestyle accessory from a globally trusted brand.

Perfect Fit for Daily Essentials

The backpack comes with well-defined storage space that keeps everything organized. With a capacity of 17 Ltr, it is ideal for carrying books, documents, gadgets, chargers, and personal items. It includes a dedicated compartment that securely holds a 14 inch laptop, ensuring safety during travel or commuting. The well-cushioned laptop sleeve offers added protection, making it a reliable choice for professionals and students alike.

Compact, Lightweight & Travel-Friendly

Designed for comfort, the Tommy Hilfiger Urbana Laptop Backpack features adjustable shoulder straps that reduce load pressure, making it ideal for extended wear. Despite offering ample space, it weighs only 474 gm, making it one of the most lightweight backpacks in this segment. This makes it a convenient carry-on for business travel, weekend trips, and everyday commuting.

Premium Build & Stylish Look

Tommy Hilfiger is known for its exceptional design philosophy that blends fashion with purpose. The Urbana Backpack embodies this with a clean, structured silhouette and iconic branding that elevates your overall style. Whether paired with business casuals or smart everyday wear, the backpack complements every outfit effortlessly, showcasing the brand’s signature aesthetics.

Optimized Size for Everyday Convenience

The backpack is thoughtfully engineered with ideal dimensions for regular use — L 31cm X W 15cm X H 46cm. This compact yet spacious structure ensures ease of storage without compromising on capacity. The measurements help maintain balance, comfort, and a streamlined look, making it your go-to accessory for urban lifestyles.

Why Choose the Tommy Hilfiger Urbana Laptop Backpack?

With growing demand for branded laptop bags, office backpacks, student bags, and everyday carriers, Tommy Hilfiger remains one of the most trusted and high-search-volume brands globally. The Urbana series continues to stand out for its durability, modern appeal, and user-friendly features — making it an ideal investment for those seeking top-quality branded backpacks online.

Key Features

  • Brand: Tommy Hilfiger – inspired by classic American cool style
  • Model: Urbana Laptop Backpack
  • Dimensions: L 31cm X W 15cm X H 46cm
  • Weight: 474 gm
  • Laptop Size Support: Fits up to 14 inch laptops
  • Capacity: 17 Ltr
  • Lightweight, durable, and ideal for daily use
  • Multiple compartments for organized storage
  • Ergonomic and comfortable shoulder straps
  • Premium branding and stylish contemporary design

The Tommy Hilfiger Urbana Laptop Backpack is a reliable and stylish companion that elevates your everyday routine. With its perfect blend of design, features, and brand value, it remains a top choice for anyone seeking a durable, lightweight, and premium backpack from a globally recognized brand.
